            out = m.solve_beta_m97_c01_batch_01(case)

        print(f'bank {b}: {len(ii)} real sweeps; max held-out raw, weights, terminal errors: {worst}; max profiled observation error: {np.max(np.abs(profiled[rows] - g["r_y"][rows])):.3g}')
